summary.text: Brad Simon, a Republican from Paris, represents Arkansas Senate District 26, which includes parts of Franklin, Johnson, Logan and Sebastian counties.

paragraphs.text: The Arkansas Democrat-Gazette reported on April 8, 2026, that Simon was sworn in on the state Senate floor by Karen Baker, chief justice of the Arkansas Supreme Court; the legislature's member page lists his Senate service as 2026.
The legislature's member page lists Simon's occupation as small business owner.
